info.title: Filestar CLI
info.description: Filestar converts, compresses, resizes, renames and transforms files: thousands of formats (documents, images, audio, video, 3D, CAD, archives, embroidery and more) from one app or the command line (filestarcli). Many conversions run locally; some use Filestar's cloud.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Filestar: convert, resize, compress and edit files from the command line.
